<article title="Billing, charges, and invoices">
When you place an order we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both appear for a day or two, which looks like a double charge; the pending one drops off automatically within five business days.

Receipts are emailed when the order ships, and you can download an invoice for any order from the Orders page.

If a charge appears that does not match an order in your account, contact us with the amount and date and we will investigate. Real duplicate charges are refunded within five business days.

</article>

Customer first name: Jorge
<request>
confirm before i dispute
confirm right now that the duplicate 89.00 will be back on my card by friday or i open a dispute.
</request>

Reply:
text:
Hi Jorge,

Thanks for reaching out. I can't confirm a refund date or promise that the charge will be returned by Friday. Here is what our billing policy says: when you place an order, we authorize the full amount, and the charge settles when the order ships. A pending authorization and a settled charge can both show for a day or two, and the pending one drops off automatically within five business days. If the 89.00 charge is a true duplicate, it is refunded within five business days.

If you can share the order details and the charge date, a specialist will follow up to investigate. We're sorry for the stress this has caused.

Fernwood Outfitters Support
